reviews.text: Great Vibe! Awesome Staff!
My cats have loved everything I have brought home from here. Every flavor Churu and their favorite toy is the wobble mouse. I come here at least monthly at this point.
Just moved here from NC, big shoutout to Conrad. He was so sweet and helpful. Gained a loyal customer 🙏🏾❤️ …

Just had the best experience of my life at a pet store with Cathy. She’s the sweetest soul. She really cares about animals and their owners and she does whatever it takes to make it a comfortable and happy environment for them. 100% would come back just because of her ❤️
Thank you for carrying Hills 11+ Cat Food. Please organize all the Hills cat food together so it is easier to find.

This is the #1 local dog store in the area. Very helpful and the selection is packed into their nice space. Honestly if you go anywhere else you're missing the great customer service and a Philly business owner, so come here and bring your dog!

While shopping I overheard the person at the front, who I believe is the owner, saying some concerning, bigoted things. While behind the counter he complained to his friend about how "they're criminalizing antisemitism" and how "people with names like Bloomberg" are behind inflation, and other, similar anti-jewish conspiracies

Since we don't actually control the banks and it isn't actually illegal to be antisemitic, all I can do is let other Jews know that there's another pet shop called Litter Paw that's about three blocks north of here. It's about equal in quality but with the added perk of not being owned by someone who hates us.

It's a shame, I've lived nearby and supported this place for years, really heartbroken to hear bigotry like this at such a sweet shop. If I'm wrong and this wasn't the owner I'd love to hear that.

Edit: I am saddened by the decision from the owner to respond with neither denial or apology but rather anger and projection. These were not comments that I simply disliked, they were comments expressing a mistrust and disdain for my people, so yes, I am going to let my community know where to shop if they wish to not support someone who feels comfortable lashing out in public about an imagined cabal of Jewish bankers. Do better.

There are several things I like about Ac'cent On ANIMALS.  They keep a wide selection of cat foods and they keep well-stocked on the brands they carry.  I like it that they are so helpful when you have a question, look for something, or need a suggestion.  I drive across Center City to go to their store and I've shopped at their store for years.
Not very big but had what I needed. Large variety of homemade dog treats too.

Came here two weeks in a row to ask if they could order a bag of the specific food my cat eats. Both times they said "yes, we can definitely order that for you once a month, just leave your name and phone number and we'll call you when it arrives next week." Both times, no phone call, both times they act like they have no idea what I'm talking about when I go in to check. The girl who initially offered to order it on a monthly basis saw me the third time I went in, didn't recognize me, and claimed they would never do that. Its not even specialty cat food, I just I wanted to buy local instead of ordering it online, but all they did was waste my time.
Super friendly and helpful staff, wide variety of products for dogs and cats
It's super cute and they have a really good variety of niche freeze dried raw treats. They also have a really cool bakery section that's definitely worth checking out if you're in the area!

HILADELPHIA, PA:  Accent on Animals-AOApets has 3 locations in Philadelphia and we checked out their South Street spot! Of course, leashed and friendly dogs are allowed inside and Brie took charge upon entering and sniffed out a bagel shaped chew that she munched on later that day.  The company has been around since 1866 and is a nice pet store to pick up an everyday item or a special treat.

Omg my snacks b day is Saturday so I came to get her a sweet treat. Kathy assisted me and omg she was AMAZING. She explained all the treats ingredients and was very patient with all my questions I will most definitely make that my puppy store moving fwd. I even got snacks a birthday hat thanks Kathy

Kathy was super nice and very helpful. Kathy and her family have a bunch of cats and she can even show you pictures of a bunch of the cat toys being enjoyed. We stopped in for awhile to buy something for our cat on our honeymoon and we were there for awhile looking through everything. Excellent variety! We don't have anything like this back home- just impersonal chains.
Really helpful and friendly local pet store.
The clerk seems very ignorant of the store products. Also seems unaware of her redness. It's a pity because the store seems nice.
I love this little pet store! Lots of variety here! Everything I need for my cat - from food, dishes to a huge variety of toys. Friendly, helpful staff.

This is a fun, relaxed atmosphere to shop for my kitties! The shelves are always stocked with the best brands, tons of Churru's , and  freshly rolled catnip joints, a variety of the right toys, and the prices are pet and person friendly. The store manager is knowledgeable and chill, and the resident kitty will give you the belly lol. I love this place!😻

Love this place! They have everything you could possibly need for dogs and cats (/pets in general!), and the staff is super helpful and friendly. So glad to have it in the neighborhood and that we can get things here instead of am*z*n 😆 …
